purpose: Exact authored-lesson inventory for Ready for Life and Financial Literacy, derived from source rather than asserted, plus the reasons full production coverage is not certifiable from this source.

existingSliceCoverage.note: 24 of the 396 authored lessons carry production student-work packages. 4 of those 24 are grade-09-hs packages whose declared source does not exist (see blockers.fabricatedHighSchoolProvenance).
existingSliceCoverage.answerKeyAudit: All 12 shipped FinLit scoring records carry distinct, arithmetically verifiable fixed answer keys (12 of 12 payloads distinct). The shipped slice is genuinely authored; the gate blind spot is a scaling risk, not a defect in these 24.

blockers.noHighSchoolSource: Grades 9-12 were requested but no ref in this repository (524 refs scanned) contains any curriculum-content for grade 9, 10, 11, or 12. There is nothing to derive lesson counts or student work from. Verified by tests/inventory.test.ts.
blockers.fabricatedHighSchoolProvenance: The four shipped grade-09-hs packages declare integrity.sourceCorpusVersion '1.1.0' and sourceLessonId 'ma-g9-*'. curriculum-content/manuel-academy/1.1.0 has never existed in repository history, so these four packages cite a nonexistent source. corpus-manifest.json repeats the same nonexistent path under generatedFrom.highSchool.
blockers.sourceCarriesNoAnswerContent: answer_or_scoring_guidance is byte-identical across every lesson in every course and contains no digits and no answers. materials, mastery_rule, and safety_and_privacy are likewise single-valued per course. The only per-lesson signal is focus/title/student_activity, so the 216 FinLit answer keys required by the gate cannot be derived from source and must be authored and verified individually.
blockers.gateCannotDetectThis: evaluateLessonProductionReadiness accepts that same generic string as a valid fixed ANSWER_KEY and returns READY with no notes. Passing the Production Quality Gate is therefore necessary but not sufficient evidence of FinLit readiness; a mass-generated corpus would report READY while shipping no real answers. Pinned by tests/gateAnswerKeyBlindSpot.test.ts.

whatFullCoverageActuallyRequires.detail: 396 lessons x (1 student-facing task sheet + 1 adult-only scoring record). Per the fidelity of the shipped slice, each needs a concrete lesson-specific real task, safety notes, a simulation alternative where the task is real-world, remediation and extension, and either a verified fixed answer key (FinLit, 216 lessons) or an authored rubric (RFL, 180 lessons). This is curriculum authoring, not pipeline scaling: the pipeline in ../ready-for-life-financial-literacy/src is already grade-agnostic and needs no change.
